data.long_meaning: The name Ginsburg is derived from the German language. It is composed of two elements: 'Gin' meaning 'hill' or 'hillman' and 'Burg' meaning 'fortress' or 'castle'. This name was commonly given to people who lived near or on a hill with a fortress or castle. The name Ginsburg carries the meaning “Hillman, from the hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ginsburg usually hope their child will grow to embody hillman, from the hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
